close_reason: Verified in code — implementation matches decision exactly.
description: MdnSendResponse::not_sent (and notParsable in MdnParseResponse) uses serde_json::Value rather than a concrete SetError type. This avoids an upward dependency from jmap-mail-types onto jmap-server, which would create a dependency cycle (jmap-server depends on jmap-mail-types). The design preserves the no-async-in-types-crate rule and the crate hierarchy; the doc comment on MdnSendResponse records this reasoning explicitly.
title: DECISION: notSent typed as Value in types crate to avoid upward dep
